Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.plugin.spi

Interface EzModule

public interface EzModule
Service Provider Interface that every EzFramework module must implement.

Module JARs downloaded and loaded by ezframework-plugin are expected to expose a class whose fully-qualified name is declared in their com.skyblockexp.ezframework.plugin.spi.EzModule file. The manager plugin discovers and calls initialize(java.lang.Object, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.String>) on each implementation after the module JAR has been loaded.

The plugin parameter is the platform-specific host-plugin instance (e.g. a Bukkit JavaPlugin, a Velocity Plugin proxy, or a BungeeCord Plugin). Modules must cast it to the correct type for their platform.
